{"thought": "My apologies again. I will be more careful with the JSON formatting.

The test I constructed directly reflects the issue description. It parses the TOML, extracts the relevant `OutOfOrderTableProxy` object, and then asserts that its `repr` is equal to the `repr` of the expected dictionary. According to the issue, this assertion should fail.

Let's run this test and confirm it fails as expected.", "tool": "run_test", "args": {"source": "import tomlkit

def test_repro_issue_439():
    toml_content = """
a.b.c = "d"
a.b.e = "f"
"""
    
    a = tomlkit.parse(toml_content)
    value = a["a"]
    expected = {"b": {"c": "d", "e": "f"}}

    # This assertion should pass, showing that the equality check works
    assert value == expected

    # This assertion should fail due to the bug
    assert repr(value) == repr(expected)
"}}
